newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru appoints new general manager.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru appoints new general manager.

text.p: Telefonica del Peru said Wednesday it named Manuel Garcia Garcia as its general manager.
Garcia takes over from Rafael Hernandez Garcia, who leaves the post but retains his position as president of the board of directors, the company said.
Garcia, who until Wednesday held the position of corporate general manager, had worked at Spain's Telefonica de Espana and Banco Santander before joining the Peruvian telecom.
Telefonica del Peru, the Lima stock exchange's benchmark stock, is majority-owned by Telefonica de Espana after its $2.002 billion privatization in 1994.
